newsitem.title: INDIA: At least 20 killed in quake in central India.
newsitem.headline: At least 20 killed in quake in central India.

text.p: At least 20 people were killed and 150 injured in a severe earthquake that rocked central India early on Thursday, officials said.

"Twenty people have been killed and 150 have been injured in the earthquake," a spokesman of the government of Madhya Pradesh state told Reuters in the provincial capital Bhopal. Unofficial reports said at least 25 people had died.
The official said the quake's epicentre was near Jabalpur city, about 260 km (160 miles) southeast of Bhopal.
The tremor, which lasted about 20 seconds, struck at 4.22 a.m. (2252 GMT Wednesday) and measured 6.0 on the Richter scale, the state government spokesman said.
All India Radio said the quake damaged at least 500 houses.
The state government spokesman said most of the victims died when their houses collapsed on them in Jabalpur.
United News of India (UNI) said at least 25 were killed. A journalist working with a daily newspaper in Jabalpur said 27 had died.
In September 1993, some 10,000 people died in neighbouring Maharashtra state when a quake measuring 6.3 on the Richter scale struck the Latur-Osmanabad region.
